blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu is pursuing a five-point action plan to address water supply gaps, reduce water-related risks and strengthen resource management as the province prepares for the threat of El Niño and prolonged dry conditions. The plan emerged from the two-day Cebu Water Summit 2026 held on November 17 and 18 at the Capitol Social Hall. It will be elevated to the Provincial Development Council (PDC) and Regional Development Council (RDC) for possible integration into the province’s development priorities, investment programming and annual budget.
